run_opt_in_out_filter: run the script to filter image URLs by opt-out status using the Spawning AI API
check_spawning_api: check a list of image URLs against the Spawning AI opt-out API endpoint
parallel_opt_in_out_task: process batches of image URLs in parallel to determine their opt-out status
opt_in_out_batch: run an async task synchronously to get opt-out booleans for a batch of URLs
save_opt_out_dataset: save the filtered opt-out dataset to disk and sync it to S3 storage
